speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Dermoscopy not performed; clinical inspection noted a rough, scaly plaque on the left dorsal hand with no tenderness. Histopathology from skin biopsy revealed hyperkeratosis with parakeratosis, solar elastosis, and atypical keratinocytes confined to the epidermis, consistent with actinic keratosis.
